description: Computer vision pipeline: YOLO-based detection and ByteTrack multi-object tracking, field calibration (auto + manual), coordinate transformation from pixel space to real-world field coordinates. Implements all tracking modes (single player, ball carrier, ball only, group tracking) with analytics computation (routes, speeds, distances).
steps: Implement backend/src/cv/__init__.py and backend/src/cv/detector.py: YOLOv8 detector class using ultralytics library.
Implement backend/src/cv/tracker.py: Multi-object tracker using ByteTrack (IoU-based).
Implement backend/src/cv/calibration.py: Field calibration module (AutoCalibrator + ManualCalibrator).
Write tests: All CV unit tests with mocked YOLO model.
acceptance_criteria: Detector class can be instantiated and returns Detection objects with bbox, class_id, confidence
Tracker maintains consistent track IDs across sequential detection updates
AutoCalibrator produces valid homography matrix from simulated field line detections
ManualCalibrator computes correct homography from 4 known point correspondences
HomographyTransform correctly maps pixel coordinates to field meters (verified with known test points)
AnalyticsEngine computes distance within 1% error for known trajectory inputs
Speed calculations correctly use FPS-based time intervals
All four tracking mode strategies correctly filter tracks based on their criteria
Video upload endpoint accepts multipart form data and stores files
verification: cd /workspace/rugby_Analizer-app/backend && uv run python -c "from src.cv.detector import YOLODetector; from src.cv.tracker import MultiObjectTracker; from src.cv.calibration import AutoCalibrator, ManualCalibrator; from src.cv.analytics import AnalyticsEngine; print("All CV modules import successfully")"
findings: All 9 review issues fixed and verified. Backend: 210 tests pass.
